name: surrogate_model
interface: surrogate_eval: maps body-frame (k1,k2) geometry → apparent magnitude via a residual ensemble (weights under ~/surrogate_model). Bridge-independent — needs NO retraining across the propagator convention fix.  [in_use=True]

functions.name: predict
functions.role: The gated seam: body-frame sun/observer geometry + articulation + observer distance → per-epoch apparent magnitude via the ensemble.

functions.name: get_model
functions.role: Lazy loader that caches the default SurrogateModel singleton on first call (backs predict).

functions.name: full_lc_mse
functions.role: Primary optimisation residual: masked mean of (pred−target)² over all finite epochs (mag space). Re-exported by the scorer.

functions.name: bright_mse
functions.role: Bright-subset MSE — weights the glint epochs (target < threshold).

functions.name: rho
functions.role: √MSE / 0.05 — the surrogate-space relative-fit metric against the noise floor (the cheap proxy for the hi-fi ρ-band).

functions.name: nll_residual
functions.role: RF25 Eq.3 per-epoch residual vector in flux space, with optional signal rescaling (absorbs albedo/scale).

functions.name: nll_cost
functions.role: Scalar mean negative-log-likelihood (RF25 Eq.3) combining χ² data-fit and the per-epoch noise model.

versions.change_reason: First residual surrogate. Materially different cloud than v2 at TOL=0.10 mag in the cloud-survival regime (s060: IoU 0.42 at LC extrema); admission noise propagates into any q→ω derivation pipeline.
Residual ensemble used in production. Faithful in-basin (s002 argmin=truth; s014 Spearman 0.9952 outside basin). Default for all search/rank/polish; v1 is a fallback only when v2 is too slow.
